data.body:
[P2] Preserve permanent checkpoint failures after deadline settlement

If a terminal checkpoint remains in flight past the cutoff and then raises a nonretryable `CheckpointError`, the settlement wait delivers that error and `invoke_handler()` correctly produces `FAILED`. This check then sees no terminal acknowledgment and replaces the classified failure with `InvocationDeadlineExceeded`. A permanent API rejection therefore triggers another Lambda retry and loses its original error. Preserve classified nonretryable failures through both final deadline checks, and extend the terminal-transport regression with `DurableApiErrorCategory.EXECUTION`; its `OSError` case only covers retryable failures.
